name: velo
description: Velo V2 Ask, Plan, Run, and Auto modes for Codex — read-only conceptual Q&A, persisted versioned planning with an explicit approval freeze, frozen-plan execution that commits locally and never pushes, and end-to-end autonomous delivery that on Codex refuses to run without subagents and offers Plan or an attended Run instead.

interface.shortDescription: Conceptual Q&A, approval-gated planning, frozen-plan runs, and quorum-gated end-to-end delivery for Codex (Velo V2 — Ask, Plan, Run, and Auto)
interface.longDescription: Velo V2 ships four modes. Ask answers conceptual engineering questions from model knowledge and the current conversation only — it never reads the repository, runs commands, browses, uses connectors, spawns agents, or writes artifacts, and it creates no durable state of any kind. Plan turns a brief into a persisted, versioned plan saved under .velo/ — it may read the repository to plan well, writes only under .velo/, offers explicit approval that freezes the plan version, and never executes the plan. Run consumes only a plan that Plan has frozen and approved: it executes the plan milestone by milestone, gates each milestone on green checks plus one independent review, commits the work locally on the plan's milestone branches, writes only progress marks into the plan, and never pushes, merges, or opens PRs. Auto spans Plan and Run end-to-end: it drives the work to a versioned, frozen plan, takes the one explicit human approval — nothing is ever auto-approved — then delivers every milestone without further user relay, gating each milestone on green checks plus three independent cold reviews passing 2 of 3 with no unresolved blocking finding, under Run's local-commit-only scope. Codex has no subagent mechanism, so on Codex Auto refuses autonomous execution outright and offers Plan or an attended Run instead.
defaultPrompt: Ask Velo a conceptual engineering question
Talk a design trade-off through without touching the repo
Plan a feature into a saved, versioned plan under .velo/
Revise a saved plan and approve it to freeze the version
Run an approved plan milestone by milestone with local commits
Deliver a request end-to-end with Auto under one approval
